_note: Context packs for tools/pack.py. Keys starting with '_' are comments.
A pack must be self-sufficient: the topic's code, what it imports, and
the docs that argue for it. 'brief' is mandatory and attached first.
Rewritten 2026-09-13. The set had been cut for a ~5 000 line project and
described it as of 2026-09-12; by then 4 739 lines - the whole cloud
library, the porting CLI, derived formats, the push, and ALL of
houdini/ - sat in no named pack at all. 'ui' had meanwhile grown to 79k
on a 'ui/**' glob covering two subjects that never come up together.

brief.description: The minimum: what the project is, its rules, today's state. Attach this first, always.

docs.description: All documentation, not one line of code.

ingest.description: The import pipeline: what is guessed, where it lands, what is written.
ingest._note: port.py is here, not in its own pack: it is a thin caller of analyse+commit, and a question about bulk importing is a question about this pipeline. docs/porting.md is the procedure that goes with it.

storage.description: asset.json, the index, hashing and verification -- the 'disk is truth' half.

ui.description: The windows: browser, Add, Edit, Contents, and the threading rules around them.
ui._note: Listed file by file rather than 'ui/**'. The glob quietly swallowed the server half as it was written and took the pack to 79k; naming them means a new window has to be put somewhere on purpose.

remote.description: The cloud library: catalogue, thumbnails, downloads, and the push back to the master.
remote._note: Includes server/client-contract.md deliberately - it is the WHY for every decision in these files, and a pack that forces you to open the contract separately is cut wrong. server/api.py is the other half of the same conversation and is small.

houdini.description: The adapter: Karma/MTLX/Solaris node building, the seam, and .rat generation.
houdini._note: houdini/ was in NO pack until 2026-09-13, which is 1 843 lines including the 1 324-line builder. import_houdini.py is in here as well as in 'ui' because the options are decided there and obeyed here - reading one without the other is how the two drift.

all.description: Everything: assetlib, ui, houdini and config.
